next_step_summary: PR #281 adds Expert Pack v0.1 as a three-file experimental reasoning packet: compact core protocol, mechanism playbook, and 15 contrastive expert examples. It records that merged PR #280 was design-only and did not update canonical state or change the Question Engine track. No runtime/provider/schema/privacy/OCR/dependency behavior changes in #281. The next bounded step is to run the same already-reviewed March-August 2025 contract with the Expert Pack as the expert reasoning input and without the legacy Questionnaire/Skeleton, then compare concrete reading errors before changing production runtime or broadening to other contracts.
